name: Climate futures
description: Future climate data (SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5, 2050 and 2080) for Address to site (flood level, wildfire, heat), present beside future. Data: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 (CMIP6 model output, CC BY 4.0) and IPCC AR6 sea level. The bundled pack is a SAMPLE (three places, one model, five years per period): for trying the tools, not for design.
author: CadCraft
